ui.cashHint: The unit's daily cash register: payments, manual movements and closing.

ui.revenuesHint: Revenue that does not come from patients, such as renting a room.
ui.statementHint: All revenues and expenses of a unit and period, with a running balance.

ui.movementHint: Money in and out that does not come from patient payments.

ui.name: Name
ui.attachmentHint: PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB.
ui.attachmentInvalid: Send a PDF, JPG or PNG file of up to 10 MB.
